shots.action: A coil of smoke rises in darkness and forms the silhouette of a dragon, then parts.
Misty mountain temple at dusk, red paper lanterns glowing, fog rolling between carved pillars.
Macro: glossy red chili-ginger sauce pours over steaming noodles, lantern light reflecting off the glaze.
The Sauce Empire bottle among red lanterns, warm glow, a wisp of dragon-smoke curling past.
